description: This file defines configuration handling for WLD (Wireless Link Device) sync modes, including enums, string mappings, getter functions, and a parameter change handler.

methods.name: wld_config_getEnableSyncMode
methods.description: Returns the current sync mode enum value.

methods.name: wld_config_getEnableSyncModeStr
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the current sync mode.

methods.name: wld_config_isEnableSyncNeeded
methods.description: Determines if sync is needed based on current mode and direction.

methods.name: s_setEnableSyncMode_pwf
methods.description: Sets the sync mode based on a string input, invoked as a parameter change handler.

methods.name: _wld_config_setConf_ocf
methods.description: Handles configuration events for WLD sync mode.
